svg.title: ORION: two VPCs, IAM-authorized AgentCore tools, and daily graph ingestion
svg.desc: AgentCore Runtime uses PUBLIC networking outside the two workload VPCs. IAM authorizes Runtime to Gateway and Gateway to VPC-attached Lambda. The Lambda connects privately to Neptune. EventBridge triggers a bounded Multiple Myeloma refresh via S3 and a private ingestion Lambda.

text.tspan: ORION — AgentCore, Knowledge Graph and Ingestion
Two workload VPCs • IAM-authorized tool calls • Public evidence → S3 → private Neptune ingestion
IAM roles authorize service API calls.
Monarch API + pinned DisMech Multiple Myeloma YAML
Bounded extraction; preserve identifiers, evidence and source URLs
MM / JMML enrichment • Open Targets • DisMech → PubMed → ClinicalTrials.gov
Archive original records in S3; these enrichments are outside the daily MM-only refresh.
The researcher opens the chat and existing interactive visualizations.
The application calls AgentCore Runtime with IAM-authorized, signed requests.
The Runtime selects typed tools and preserves follow-up conversation context.
The Runtime role permits bedrock-agentcore:InvokeGateway using SigV4.
The Gateway role permits lambda:InvokeFunction; the tool queries Neptune in VPC 2.
EventBridge starts the fetch Lambda daily for the bounded MM source set.
Fetch archives S3 snapshots and a manifest, then directly invokes private ingestion.
Ingestion reads S3 via its gateway endpoint, verifies hashes and upserts Neptune.
IAM authorizes service calls; it does not create a network connection between VPCs. Runtime is currently PUBLIC; no direct VPC peering is shown.
Solid arrows: data / API calls Dashed arrows: scheduled or direct invocation | Public or synthetic data only | No Step Functions
